'''''Ko''''' was a modified [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 transport]] that was used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. The smugglers attempted to escape an [[XQ3 Platform]] '''[[AZ 77 (Venzeiia 2)|AZ 77]]''' that was part of a salvage yard that was also harboring fugitives, including a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. A [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] equipped with a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] was assigned to disable any transport that tried to escape the station, the fighter was escorted by [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] to provide support. After [[Lin (starship)|''Lin'']] was disabled the '''Ko''' was soon afterwards launched and it tried to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]]. The transport was disabled and an [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|assault transport]] boarded the YT-1300 and captured it. The events surrounding '''AZ 77''' were recorded and recreated to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]] such as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] in the [[Combat chamber]].
